subject: formatting of labels in legends from trans_format

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: formatting of labels in legends from trans_format
parts:
Hi everyone

I'm having trouble formatting the labels in legends when inversing a transformation. As an example, consider the following:

test <- data.frame(expand.grid(1:10, 1:10), value=runif(100, min=1, max=1000))


p <- qplot(Var1, Var2, data=test, geom='tile', fill=value)


If I where to log transform the fill scale and furthermore do something to the labels and breaks, I would add

p + scale_fill_gradient(trans='log10', guide=guide_colorbar(), breaks=trans_breaks('log10', function(x) 10^x), labels=trans_format('log10', math_format()))


The problem is that the labels are plotted as unevaluated calls and thus not very pretty... I have tried different permutations of using eval(), parse() and expression() around trans_format() without luck... Is it not possible to put expression as legend labels when dealing with scale transformations?

best wishes

Thomas

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: formatting of labels in legends from trans_format
parts:
I was playing and it looks like the problem is as.name(). It puts single backwards quotes around the number which do not get parsed. When I took it out it seemed to work ok... check attachment. 

>math_format
function (expr = 10^.x, format = force) 
{
    quoted <- substitute(expr)
    subs <- function(x) {
        do.call("substitute", list(quoted, list(.x = as.name(x))))
    }
    function(x) {
        x <- format(x)
        llply(x, subs)
    }
}
<environment: namespace:scales>

p + scale_fill_gradient(trans='log10', guide=guide_colorbar(), breaks=trans_breaks('log10', function(x) 10^x), labels=trans_format('log10', math_format()))
